walkthroughs.body_html:
Area of Study 1: Instrumental Music 1700-1820 — a core area of GCSE Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area of Study 1: Instrumental Music 1700-1820 brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area of Study 1: Instrumental Music 1700-1820.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: To provide contrast before the final chorus, often by changing melody, key, or texture.

A single melody with chord accompaniment.

It has only five notes.
The seventh degree is raised by a semitone (creating a leading note).
